description: The score-card tests exercise only small FINANCIAL ratios and do not cover a valid safe-integer boundary ratio produced by the core. Consequently they pass while the renderer rejects the legal value=10 payload identified in FIND-004, leaving the post-Phase-5 integer-safe rounding regression unguarded at the presentation boundary.

evidence.snippet: The executable valid model uses financial numerator=700/denominator=1000, and the contradictory-ratio matrix uses only 100/100; no safe-integer boundary ratio is rendered.
evidence.testName: fresh Node reproduction with numerator=945755921642804 denominator=9007199253740991 produced core value=10 and renderer rejection
